title: 36 Hours in Vienna
abstract: The Austrian capital beckons as a wintry escape with ice skating paths, cozy coffeehouses and a Christmas market in a palace.

title: 36 Hours at Joshua Tree
abstract: Unwind, stargaze and explore a dreamlike landscape in California’s high desert.

title: 36 Hours in Córdoba, Spain
abstract: Meet history at every turn in this southern Spanish city with Roman ruins, spectacular Moorish architecture and a Jewish quarter with picturesque alleys.

title: 36 Hours in Hong Kong
abstract: Experience the incense-filled neighborhoods, thought-provoking art and hilltop views of this glittering, international metropolis at a moment of deep political transformation.
